Registry shim ONLY -- the real logic is src/options/short_premium.py (entry, per-leg SL, time exit), driven by orchestrator._options_intraday_short_premium2_loop every poll_seconds, rules in config/options_settings.json options_trading.options_intraday_short_premium2 (every parameter editable there, applied on the next tick). entry_conditions are deliberately impossible (RSI > 1000) so this spec never fires through the per-bar USS scan (same shim as options_expiry_day.json and options_intraday_short_premium.json); direction MUST stay LONG. 'enabled' in the registry IS a live switch, and this name is what CRM G9 llm_gate_required, execution_mode and the G7 uncapped exemption key on.
